name: smartshroom-scm-root
description: Root runner scripts for Smart Shroom SCM (Frontend, Backend, and IoT Simulator)

scripts.dev:all: npx -y concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:full: npx -y concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,IOT" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "cd backend && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "python iot_simulator.py --local --interval 10"
